summary: Verified both new features end-to-end. (1) Player pages show Marktwert correctly in header + sidebar: Messi 30.0 Mio €, Haaland 175.0 Mio €, Mbappé 180.0 Mio €. Player detail API returns market_value (int) and market_value_date. (2) Club pages show Kadergrösse and Kaderwert derived from real player DB: Bayern 35 Spieler / 304.5 Mio €, Real Madrid 4 Spieler / 490.0 Mio €. Kader tab renders real players with name, position and market value (verified Kylian Mbappé 180.0 Mio €, Bellingham 150.0 Mio €, Vinícius 150.0 Mio €, Modrić 10.0 Mio € under Kader tab for Real Madrid; Bayern kader includes Neuer/Kimmich/Ulreich etc via API). Sidebar 'Wertvollste Spieler' shows top players sorted desc by market value with avatars, name, position and Mio € values. API /api/players?current_club_id=<id> returns filtered squad for both Bayern (35) and Real Madrid (4).

issues: Only ~5-10 of the 35 Bayern squad rows show market value; the remainder show blank/dash which is expected (data seeded only for top players), but rows without market_value could be visually deprioritised (e.g. lighter row) so the table doesn't look half-empty.
Format '30.0 Mio. €' shows the trailing zero even for round numbers; formatting could drop unnecessary decimals (e.g. '30 Mio €') for cleaner UX. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/players?current_club_id=X returns the full player object list; for large clubs (Bayern=35) this is fine, but consider pagination or projection (id, name, position, market_value) for future scalability.

Kaderwert on club page is computed client-side by summing player.market_value; if some players have null market_value they are silently excluded. Consider surfacing '(x/y Spieler mit Marktwert)' for transparency.
market_value stored as int (Euro units) — good; but market_value_date is a plain string. Consider ISO date field with Pydantic validation.

success_rate.backend: 100% (players/slug messi/haaland/mbappe, clubs/slug, players?current_club_id for Bayern and Real Madrid all return correct data)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (both player Marktwert display and club Kader/Kaderwert/Wertvollste Spieler verified visually)

seed_data_creation: None; used existing seeded top players with market values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both requested features (player market_value + club squad view) verified working. Bayern squad has 35 players seeded but only ~7 top players (Neuer 8M, Kimmich 60M, Musiala, Kane, Davies 70M, Upamecano 50M, Gnabry 45M, Luis Díaz 70M) have market_value set; rest are null. Real Madrid has only 4 seeded players (Mbappé, Bellingham, Vinícius, Modrić) — expected per problem statement. Kader tab click required force=True but works. No bugs found.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification pass; all acceptance criteria met.
